notes.title: The release of Medium5: Rebirth will delay
notes.content: [p]IWe feel sorry to announce that the release of Medium5: Rebirth will delay, due to the departure of the programmer. This project will continue and our game is still in development.[/p]

notes.title: ✡Get a badge of Medium5: Rebirth for FREE!✡
notes.content: [p]The Steam store page of "Medium 5: Rebirth" is open now! Welcome to add our game to your wish list~[/p][p]This game is still under development and we will release a free demo  as soon as possible. Due to the large amount of text in this game, the production process including proofreading and testing requires a lot of time. Please be patient and wait.[/p][p][/p][p]The opening of the store page was much later than we expected due to some unexpected factors. To express our apologies,  [u]all friends who have added the game "Medium5: Rebirth" to their wish list can get a [b]FREE[/b] badge from Beichen (you may refer to the attached image in this announcement for the effect picture, the physical printing does not include the X-shaped pattern in the picture)![/u] Please take a screenshot of your wish list and send it to the store manager (customer service) of 北辰社周边部 (Taobao store name) for registration. After the store manager confirms with you, you can receive it. (Express fees required)[/p][p]This badge is limited to 1 portion per person.[/p][p][/p][p]Subscribe Beichen in Bilibili or weibo to get the latest information of our game![/p][p][b]Bilibili：北辰社[/b][/p][p][b]Weibo：北辰社_Polaris[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658816/b9864d6f7bc4371d04db51490ca5ae6eefa43903.png"][/img][/p]
